```yaml
name: Sync Wiki

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    paths:
      - 'current/docs/**'

jobs:
  sync:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Configure Git
        run: |
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"

      - name: Clone wiki repository
        run: |
          git clone https://x-access-token:${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}@github.com/jpicklyk/task-orchestrator/wiki.git wiki

      - name: Copy docs to wiki
        run: |
          rsync -a current/docs/ wiki/

      - name: Check for changes
        id: check
        run: |
          git -C wiki diff --quiet || echo "changed=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Commit and push changes to wiki
        if: steps.check.outputs.changed == 'true'
        uses: EndBug/add-and-commit@v9
        with:
          add: .
          cwd: wiki
          message: "Sync docs to wiki"
          push: true
          author_name: "github-actions[bot]"
          author_email: "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
